name: TCL 55C815
summary: TCL 55C815 ships with TCL analytics, content feeds and recommendation rows. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This Danish TCL runs Android TV 11 and ships with TCL analytics, partner app attribution and a Play auto-install stub. The home screen has a TCL Channel content feed, recommendation rows and a recommended apps showcase, and TCL adds a message and promo box and a shop-mode sticker. Google extras and setup helpers are listed too.

The list is short at eighteen apps. TidyTV turns them off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything, so each one can be switched back on. Several TCL system apps are kept on purpose so the remote and Wi-Fi keep working.
keep: Live TV (the TCL TV app) and the tuner and HDMI service
The partner customizer that runs the remote's keys
The setup app, which holds a saved Wi-Fi network
notes: Some apps the factory already turned off, such as the UK catch-up apps, are left alone.
TCL's updater can turn the content feed back on after a restart. Hide it in the launcher too.

faq.a: Yes. This list does not turn off TCL's firmware updater.

faq.q: Will it stop the ads on the home screen?
faq.a: It turns off the TCL content feed, the recommended apps showcase, the message and promo box and the recommendation rows.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything turns every app back on and puts the stock Android TV home screen back.
